name: AMT Memory
description: Persistent, scoped agent memory (personal / team / org) for ChatGPT, backed by Azure Cosmos DB via the Inference Platform gateway.

authentication.note: The gateway advertises MCP OAuth discovery (/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, Dynamic Client Registration, Authorization Code + PKCE). ChatGPT drives a Microsoft (Entra) browser sign-in when the connector is added; no client secret is stored in ChatGPT.

tools_note: Adding this URL exposes the full 14-tool AMT surface (add_memory, search_memories, get_memories, summaries, reconcile, whoami, ...). For the rendered Personal/Team/Org memory widget, run the Apps SDK server in this repo instead (or in addition) - see ../README.md.

availability.internal: Enable Developer Mode (workspace admin) and grant access by RBAC.
availability.broad: Wider distribution requires OpenAI app review.
